title: Copper Bulb Light Switch
lead: Press once and the lamp comes on. Press again and it goes off. A Copper Bulb remembers!

states.label: Off
states.text: The Copper Bulb is dark, and the button is ready.

states.label: Press: on!
states.text: You press the button. Power runs along the dust, and the bulb switches on.

states.label: Still on
states.text: The button pops back out, and the dust goes dark. The bulb stays lit! It does not need power to keep shining.

states.label: Press: off
states.text: Press the button again. This new pulse of power switches the bulb off.

steps: Build a post from 2 Polished Deepslate blocks. Add a Polished Deepslate Slab on top. A dark post makes the button easy to see.
Place 3 Tuff Bricks in a row on the ground, next to the post.
Put a Tuff Brick Wall at the end of the row. Put the Copper Bulb on top of it.
Add a Copper Trapdoor on top of the bulb as a lamp cap.
Put Redstone Dust on top of each Tuff Brick.
Put a Stone Button on the front of the post, at the same height as the dust. Press it once, then press it again.
how: A Stone Button sends power for 1 second, then stops. A short burst like this is called a pulse. Each pulse that reaches a Copper Bulb flips it: off to on, or on to off. The bulb keeps shining with no power, so it remembers what the last pulse did.
tips: Crafting Copper Bulbs takes 3 Blocks of Copper, 1 Blaze Rod and 1 Redstone Dust. You get 4 bulbs. Blaze Rods come from the Nether. Get a grown-up to help, or build this one in Creative.
While power reaches a Copper Bulb, a small red dot shows in its middle.
A new Copper Bulb gives light level 15. As it turns green, that drops to 12, then 8, then 4. Wax it with a Honeycomb to keep it bright.
